source_terms: Unmodified official release; shared LGPL-2.1-or-later build, GPL/nonfree/version3 disabled. Redistribute the complete byte-exact corresponding source archive, packaging/ffmpeg/build_ffmpeg.py and this lock alongside binaries; retain all original notices. End users must remain able to replace/relink the shared libraries. No original game assets are included.

provenance.verification: GnuPG GOODSIG and VALIDSIG matched the fingerprint published on the official release download page before source inspection; SHA-256 derived from the authenticated archive. No source execution during acquisition.

decoder_dependency: wmv3 selects the internal vc1 decoder; wmv1/wmv2 select msmpeg4dec (+ intrax8, wmv2dsp); wmav1/wmav2 select sinewin and wma_freqs. ASF carries complete packets, so no parsers are enabled. swresample converts WMA planar float to interleaved 44.1 kHz stereo; swscale converts WMV YUV 4:2:0 to RGBA.
notice_scope: Original COPYING.LGPLv2.1, LICENSE.md and CREDITS plus initial source notice comments from every C/header/assembly/build-source file in the five libraries, compat and ffbuild (includes disabled source components); complete notices are retained in the corresponding-source archive. LICENSE.txt concatenates these byte-exact generated inputs in listed order excluding itself.
